summary: Compute the Sauter dimensionless bootstrap fit coefficients from explicit face collisionalities

identity.definition: For Sauter, L31/L34 use their effective trapped fractions and quartic polynomial; L32 sums the distinct ee/ei rational-polynomial fits. Redl uses its revised fits and L34=L31. Alpha=(B+a*y)/(1+c*y), y=nu_i_star^2*f_trap^6; Sauter(a,c)=(.315,.15), Redl(-.002,.004), with model-specific B. Binary exponent scaling evaluates y or 1/y without squaring overflow or logarithmic cancellation.
identity.coordinates: rho normalized radius; psi total flux Wb
identity.boundary: First current face at magnetic axis exactly zero; other gradients explicit
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: f_trap
inputs.description: Caller-supplied trapped-particle fraction, not inverse aspect ratio

inputs.name: nu_e_star
inputs.description: Caller-supplied electron collision/bounce frequency ratio under the model convention

inputs.name: Z_eff
inputs.description: Effective ionic charge for the fit
inputs.constraints: Sauter positive; Redl >=1; physical quasineutral fully ionized plasma Z_eff>=1

inputs.name: nu_i_star
inputs.description: Caller-supplied ion collision/bounce frequency ratio under the model convention

outputs.name: coefficients
outputs.description: Tuple in exact order (L31,L32,L34,alpha), each dimensionless face array
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Compute the Sauter dimensionless bootstrap fit coefficients from explicit face collisionalities
excluded: Empirical coefficients are not experimentally calibrated here. Caller must supply model-consistent collisionalities and trapped fraction; no geometry reconstruction, edge pedestal or full TORAX physics qualification.
Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for malformed, nonfinite, masked, mismatched or out-of-domain face inputs; no partial result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite coefficient/current arithmetic; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; these are direct analytic fit and arithmetic mappings.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

example.code:
from scirel.neoclassical import calculate_sauter_coefficients
L31,L32,L34,alpha=calculate_sauter_coefficients([0.,0.],[0.,0.],[1.,1.],[0.,0.])
assert (L31==0).all() and (L32==0).all() and (L34==0).all()

scope: Independent Decimal fit checks, source-bound coefficient/caller parity and finite arithmetic regressions
verification.evidence_ceiling: Mathematical fit arithmetic and explicit assembly only; no empirical full-physics qualification.
known_limitations: Empirical coefficients are not experimentally calibrated here. Caller must supply model-consistent collisionalities and trapped fraction; no geometry reconstruction, edge pedestal or full TORAX physics qualification.
Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.
